title: Acceptance Criterion
description: Schema for a BDD/Gherkin acceptance criterion produced by Agente01_ProductOwner

id.description: Unique criterion ID: AC-[story number]-[criterion number]

scenario_title.description: Short descriptive title for the scenario

given.description: One or more preconditions or context statements (the 'Given' clauses)

when.description: One or more actions performed (the 'When' clauses)

then.description: One or more expected observable outcomes (the 'Then' clauses)

type.description: Scenario type: happy_path (main success), edge_case (boundary/unusual), negative (error/unauthorized)

automatable.description: True if this criterion can be automated with Playwright or Vitest

notes.description: Additional context or test data requirements
